description: Rothco’s Flexipack MOLLE Tactical Shoulder Bag is the ideal compact travel pack for those who need a durable, versatile solution for carrying essentials. Made from 100% polyester, this tactical shoulder bag is built to withstand the rigors of outdoor activities and daily use. The bag features a 1.5 inch wide adjustable and detachable shoulder strap with a detachable shoulder pad, ensuring comfort during extended wear. The flap closure with a 2 inch wide front quick-release buckle provides easy access to your gear while keeping it secure. Inside, the bag boasts a 2-pouch interior with a drawstring closure top, perfect for organizing and securing your items. The front zipper pouch includes both an interior and exterior pocket, offering additional storage options. Measuring 12 inch x 4 inch x 6 inch, this rugged shoulder bag is compact yet spacious enough to carry your essentials. MOLLE attachment straps on the back allow for easy customization and expansion with other MOLLE-compatible gear.
